content_zh:
“您好，您所拨打的电话已关机，请稍后再拨…”
听着手机发出来的提示，他的双手不知不觉缓缓紧握，由于用力过度，指甲刺穿掌心的皮肤，鲜血顺着拳头不断的滴落而下…
可掌心内传来的痛楚，与赖大兵心中的痛楚，相对之下，根本就不算什么，一个美丽的身影在赖大兵的脑海中挥之不去。
“赖大兵，我要牵着你的手，一直到天荒地老，永远不放开，就算我们其中一个人要放开手，那也只允许我甩你，你不许甩掉我，知道吗？”
“赖大兵，你知道吗，我这一次考试又是第一名，你别老是一天到晚跟那些小流氓混在一起，那样没前途，一直这样下去的话，总有一天，我会甩掉你。”
“赖大兵，我们分手吧，我以后不想在见到你，因为我已经爱上了别人…”
为什么？为什么会这样？为什么她要跟我分手？为什么要这样对待我？赖大兵用沾满鲜血的双手不断拍打着脑袋，眼神有些茫然的注视着前方毫无波纹湖面…
“赖大兵，你说的没错，他的确比你老，比你丑，但是他比你有钱！忘记我吧，你给不了我想要的生活，当初的那些话，只不过随口说说的罢了。”
那一幕幕在次出现在赖大兵的脑海中，泪水慢慢模糊双眼，脑海中的那个身影也变得越来越模糊…
她和他已经分手，可赖大兵依然没有死心，于是约她在二零一一年十二月三十一号的晚上，一起观看那所谓千年难得一遇的流星雨，希望能挽回这个女孩。
可事实证明，她对他已经没有任何挂念，即使赖大兵发给她的最后一条短信是“如果你不来的话，那我将在天星湖结束自己的性命！”可那个女孩依然无动于衷。
时间二零一一年十二月三十一日，地点某个不知名的小湖岸边，赖大兵一步步慢慢的走向湖泊，她是他的所有，她是他的整个世界，失去她，对他来说，生存已经变得毫无意义…
走到湖边赖大兵朝着湖中心游了过去，游到湖中心，赖大兵在次拨打那个熟悉的号码，可依然是那机械般的声音，“您好，您所拨打的电话已关…”
听到这机械般的声音，赖大兵只觉得心不由来的绞疼，手缓缓是松开，手机滑落掉进水中，同时赖大兵张开双手，让身体与手机同时沉入湖底。
大量的湖水不断的从赖大兵的口鼻进入他的肺中，赖大兵只觉得他的脑袋慢慢的变得有些沉重，双眼也变得有些疲惫，透过湖水注视着天空中越来越模糊的星星，心中默念一切都结束了……
可当赖大兵觉得自己的生命就要结束的时候，只见空中一道道流星雨划过天际，那玄幻般的画面，仿佛是为他生命消失最后那一刻的庆典。
透过湖水，看着空中的一颗星星越变越大，赖大兵更加肯定，自己的生命马上就要结束，不然怎么会出现这样的幻觉？
当赖大兵眼中的那颗星星变成直径一米的带着蓝色火焰圆球时，赖大兵终于意识到事情的不对劲，此时一股庞大无比的压力使得平静湖面激荡起无数道波纹…

content_en:
"Hello, the phone you dialed has been turned off, please call again later..."
Listening to the prompts from the phone, he slowly clenched his hands unconsciously. Due to excessive force, his nails pierced the skin on his palms, and blood continued to drip down his fists...
But the pain in his palms was nothing compared to the pain in Lai Dabing's heart. A beautiful figure lingered in Lai Dabing's mind.
"Lai Dabing, I will hold your hand until the end of time and never let go. Even if one of us wants to let go, I will only be allowed to throw you away. You are not allowed to throw me away. Do you understand?"
"Lai Dabing, you know, I came first in the exam again this time. Don't hang out with those hooligans all day long. There is no future like that. If you continue like this, one day, I will get rid of you."
"Lai Dabing, let's break up. I don't want to see you again because I have fallen in love with someone else..."
Why? Why is this happening? Why did she break up with me? Why are you treating me like this? Lai Dabing kept slapping his head with his blood-stained hands, staring blankly at the ripple-free lake ahead...
"Lai Dabing, you are right. He is indeed older and uglier than you, but he is richer than you! Forget me, you can't give me the life I want. Those words you said back then were just casual remarks."
That scene appeared in Lai Dabing's mind again. Tears slowly blurred his eyes, and the figure in his mind became increasingly blurry...
She and he had broken up, but Lai Dabing still didn't give up, so he asked her to watch the so-called once-in-a-millennium meteor shower together on the night of December 31, 2011, hoping to win back the girl.
But it turned out that she no longer cared about him. Even though the last text message Lai Dabing sent her was "If you don't come, I will end my life in Tianxing Lake!" But the girl remained indifferent.
It was December 31, 2011, on the shore of an unknown small lake. Lai Dabing slowly walked towards the lake step by step. She was everything to him, and she was his whole world. Without her, for him, survival has become meaningless...
Walking to the edge of the lake, Lai Dabing swam toward the center of the lake. When he reached the center of the lake, Lai Dabing dialed the familiar number again, but the mechanical voice was still there, "Hello, the number you dialed has been turned off..."
Hearing this mechanical sound, Lai Dabing felt his heart twist involuntarily. He slowly let go of his hand, and the phone slipped and fell into the water. At the same time, Lai Dabing opened his hands and let his body and phone sink to the bottom of the lake at the same time.
A large amount of lake water continued to enter Lai Dabing's lungs from his mouth and nose. Lai Dabing felt that his head was slowly becoming a little heavier and his eyes were becoming a little tired. He stared at the increasingly blurry stars in the sky through the lake water, silently thinking that everything was over...
But when Lai Dabing felt that his life was about to end, he saw meteor showers streaking across the sky. The fantasy-like scene seemed to be a celebration for the last moment of his life's disappearance.
Through the lake, watching a star in the sky getting bigger and bigger, Lai Dabing became even more certain that his life was about to end, otherwise how could he have such an illusion?
When the star in Lai Dabing's eyes turned into a ball with blue flames one meter in diameter, Lai Dabing finally realized that something was wrong. At this time, a huge pressure caused countless ripples on the calm lake surface...
